title: Core Septet #20
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals.

An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 7, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
